name: migrate_vm
description: Migrate virtual machine. Creates a new migration task.

params.name: bwlimit
params.default: migrate limit from datacenter or storage config

params.name: force
params.description: Allow to migrate VMs which use local devices. Only root may use this option.

params.name: migration_network
params.description: CIDR of the (sub) network that is used for migration.

params.name: migration_type
params.description: Migration traffic is encrypted using an SSH tunnel by default. On secure, completely private networks this can be disabled to increase performance.

params.name: online
params.description: Use online/live migration if VM is running. Ignored if VM is stopped.

params.name: targetstorage
params.description: Mapping from source to target storages. Providing only a single storage ID maps all source storages to that storage. Providing the special value '1' will map each source storage to itself.

params.name: with-conntrack-state
params.description: Whether to migrate conntrack entries for running VMs.

params.name: with-local-disks
params.description: Enable live storage migration for local disk
